name: sparstrowgen
description: Sparstrowgen — local-first agent harness: orchestrate Claude Code / Antigravity CLI agents with scoped Obsidian-compatible memory, task board, pipelines, and cron.

scripts.//dev-env: One command to a working local environment. See scripts/dev-env.mjs for why this is a Node script rather than the Makefile multica uses. NAMES ARE PREFIXED ON PURPOSE: `up` and `env` are pnpm BUILT-INS (`pnpm up` is an alias for `pnpm update`, `pnpm env` manages Node versions), and a built-in always wins over a script of the same name. `pnpm up` therefore silently upgraded every dependency in the monorepo instead of starting anything. Do not un-prefix these.
scripts.//test: --concurrency=1 is load-bearing, not a preference. Each package spawns its own full vitest worker pool, so running five in parallel oversubscribes the CPU and apps/web fails 1-4 tests, a DIFFERENT set each run, while passing 529/529 on its own. That is KnownGaps G-59. Serialising the packages costs about a minute and buys a suite whose result means something. Use `pnpm test:parallel` if you are deliberately reproducing the flake.
